title: Provider Switching Example
goal: Introduce provider switching in small, reviewable stages while preserving the current default provider behaviour.

stages.title: Provider contract
stages.goal: Introduce a provider-neutral contract without changing current runtime behaviour.
assumptions: The existing provider path remains the default until later stages opt in to new providers.
Provider request and response types should not leak vendor-specific SDK shapes.
acceptanceCriteria: The current provider path still works through the new interface.
Unit tests cover the default provider path.

checklist: Verify provider-neutral naming in exported types.

expectedOutputs: Unit tests for the default adapter

stages.title: OpenRouter adapter
stages.goal: Add an OpenRouter adapter behind the provider-neutral contract.
assumptions: Stage 1 exposes a provider-neutral request/response contract.
Provider configuration can supply API key, base URL, and model name.
acceptanceCriteria: OpenRouter is implemented as a separate adapter.
Provider selection can choose the OpenRouter adapter without changing caller code.
Tests cover request mapping and response normalisation.

stages.title: Docs and safety boundaries
stages.goal: Document provider switching behaviour, configuration, and safety boundaries.
assumptions: Provider selection behaviour is implemented and covered by tests.
The default provider remains backward compatible.
acceptanceCriteria: README or command docs describe provider configuration.
Safety documentation explains provider switching boundaries.
No runtime code is changed in this documentation stage.
